chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Ibn Muskan, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I said, 'A woman died and left her husband.' He said, 'The wealth is for him.' He said, 'Its meaning is that there is no inheritor for her besides him.'
ai.seo_question: Who inherits a woman's entire estate if she dies leaving only her husband?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this concise narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the principle of 'exclusive inheritance' (al-mirath li-wahid), where the husband inherits the entire estate if the deceased wife has no children, parents, or siblings. This ruling underscores the husband's status as the primary male heir in the absence of other close relatives, a foundational concept in Shia fiqh derived from the general inheritance verses. The brevity of the report highlights the Imam's direct application of Quranic principles to specific familial scenarios without unnecessary elaboration.
